visual_system: Calm, clinical and trustworthy; very brand-led.
Clear pharmacy and product access framing.
Small site that prioritises credibility over volume.
site_architecture: Tiny footprint: home, pharmacies and compassionate access pages.
No programmatic location or condition surface.
Single domain, no separate app subdomain in the index.
tone_compliance: Compassionate access pages are partner focused, not pushy.
Light on disclaimers but nothing high risk.

steal.note: A safe reference point for compliance language and product framing.
Partner-focused page that adds credibility without pushing product.

avoid.evidence: Four ranking pages, 141 keywords, almost all brand.
Four ranking pages and a footprint that depends entirely on brand demand. Compliance must not become invisibility.

implications: Acacia is a safe brand fortress with no search content to speak of.
Every non-brand topic is white space against them.
We can model their compliance tone and out-build their content.

tagline: A small, compliant clinic with a tiny but loyal brand footprint. Almost no non-brand search surface — every category topic is white space against them.

eeat.notes: Clinical posture is sound but credibility signals are largely visual. No clinician bylines, no medical-page schema, freshness lags. The safe positioning is real, the visibility is thin.
